h_v_bins.convention: equal-width [left, right) intervals; final interval includes 1

definitions.macro_f1: macro-F1 within each run and h_v bin, averaged over the classes present in that bin's true labels, fixed before predictions are evaluated, with zero_division=0; when multiple fixed splits exist, seed runs are averaged within split before an unweighted mean across splits

confidence_bands.method: two-sided percentile bootstrap of independent Macro-F1 units

units_by_dataset.pubmed: 10 split-level means, each averaging 3 seed runs
units_by_dataset.ogbn-arxiv: seed-level runs, conditional on the single fixed test split
units_by_dataset.roman-empire: 10 split-level means, each averaging 3 seed runs
units_by_dataset.amazon-ratings: 10 split-level means, each averaging 3 seed runs
units_by_dataset.arxiv-year: 5 split-level means, each averaging 6 seed runs

definitions.macro_f1_display_rule: display a bin only when every independent metric unit contains at least one test node

support_bars.quantity: mean test-node count per run and h_v bin
support_bars.display_rule: display mean counts at or above one test node per run; omit bars below the displayed logarithmic range
